va_origins_boulder.blurb: Origins is a compact boulder in the Labyrinth boulderfield, part of the High Knob Landform in far southwest Virginia, where the blocks are sandstone. It holds eleven bouldering problems that run from V0 up to about V4, with most sitting between V1 and V3, so it suits warming up or an easy session. The front face is short but sustained, and a long traverse links the whole thing together. To reach it, follow the old logging road past the dark, cave-like tunnel boulder without going inside, then bear right. Origins is the final block along that stretch.
